items.title: Carmen Caramanica interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, July 27, 2011
items.q: Doc Severinsen was on this particular show, and a lot of times he wasn’t there and Tommy was there. But he said “when we do the break, let’s give the guitar player some.

ctx.x: And you’re kind of standing there like “yeah I knew this was going to work.”

I don’t know, I think there was a little puddle of sweat by the time we did both songs. But it really came out nice. And then as kind of another little pat on the back, Doc Severinsen was on this particular show, and a lot of times he wasn’t there and Tommy was there. But he said “when we do the break, let’s give the guitar player some. So there was this, I don’t know, some blues thing or something like that. And so they got to that section, and we’ll be back in a few minutes. And so he points to me and I’m…
Show Band. For about ten seconds you heard it and then it faded out for a dog food commercial or something like that.
